contrary_evidence: September exports exceeded October in nominal USD despite stronger October year-on-year growth.
Korean non-semiconductor exports increased 34% y/y and EU GDP was positive, limiting a broad industrial-collapse narrative.
China manufacturing PMI below 50 coexisted with Korea chip exports to China +133.6% by nominal value; the series observe different populations.
Korean crude physical import volume fell 6.3% while unit price rose 62%, so a larger import bill is not evidence of more barrels.
OPEC+ quota stability for December is not demonstrated physical supply or secure Gulf transit.
limitations: Primary-source fact-check was material-claim sampling rather than independent audit of every sentence or all sixteen documents.

Original September MOTIR release USD 120.94bn differs from September figure revised in the later October release; report expressly names the original September vintage and does not treat the two vintages as a homogeneous revision.
Customs values cannot isolate semiconductor units, final buyers, or investment return; September IEA Hormuz estimate is not November observed throughput.
English references [15] and [16] retain Portuguese-rendered source descriptions; links, dates, reference numbering and underlying evidence are correct.

contrary_evidence: Non-semiconductor Korean exports rose 34% by value; Korea's overall October exports were below September despite faster y/y growth.
China October PMI below 50 does not prevent sharply higher Korean semiconductor exports to China.
Euro area GDP expanded 0.4% q/q and US Q3 GDP 3.4% SAAR despite weaker household real income.
Crude-oil import physical volumes fell 6.3% even as unit prices and nominal import bills rose.
September 1 October MOTIR primary data export +83.5% and surplus $49.85bn; October $42.50bn implies a decline of $7.35bn despite strong annual chip growth.
OPEC+ November 1 maintained September production requirements for December; this quota decision does not independently establish October-November physical shipment normalization.
